description: Whether a token has paid DexScreener for visibility: its paid orders (profile, ads, community takeover) with review status and payment date, its boost purchases, and whether it is on DexScreener's top-boosted list right now, plus that list. Paid visibility isn't organic interest: boosts and ads push a token up DexScreener's lists while they last. Solana by default; any DexScreener chain id (base, ethereum, bsc…). Fails (and is not charged) if DexScreener doesn't answer. Costs $0.001 USDC per call.

chain.description: DexScreener chain id: solana, base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum… (default solana)

includeTopBoosted.description: Include DexScreener's current top-boosted tokens (default true)
